title: The Keel Maul
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, if the shards can be bound to a bar instead of just a plate.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now bind keel shards to a bloodstone bar and swing the result. Crush, where the blind-end spear is stab.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking bloodstone bar, for anyone who would rather buy than smelt.

items.name: Keel maul
items.examine: Shards off the ridge, bound to a bar and swung the slow way.
